# Phase Lessons Protocol Template (PRD §51)

File location: `docs/lessons/phase-N.md`

---

## Phase Summary
- **Phase Number & Name**: [e.g. Phase 2: Inventory & Import]
- **Completion Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Gate Status**: [PASSED | ESCALATED]

---

## 1. What Surprised Us
- [Unexpected discoveries during implementation, e.g., real document anomalies, workbook quirks]

## 2. What We Would Change
- [Design choices or abstractions that felt cumbersome in practice and should be simplified]

## 3. New Edge Cases Discovered
- [Any unpredicted real-world scenarios found; MUST be assigned an `EC-nn` ID and automated test before the next phase begins]

## 4. Runbook Updates
- [New operational instructions, troubleshooting steps, or environment flags added]
